newsitem.title: UK: Britain's PVC Millennium Dome poisonous-Greenpeace.
newsitem.headline: Britain's PVC Millennium Dome poisonous-Greenpeace.

text.p: Greenpeace environmentalists have threatened to disrupt construction of a giant dome marking Britain's celebration of the millennium because it will be covered in "poisonous" PVC.

"Very, very determined efforts will be made to stop its construction," Greenpeace executive director Lord Melchett told Peter Mandelson, the minister in charge of the grandiose project marking the turn of the century.
The dome, dogged by controversy over its funding, is to be erected at Greenwich, the London suburb on the banks of the River Thames which is the site of the meridian marking zero degrees longitude.
Melchett, whose letter was quoted by The Independent on Sunday, said the dome is "a toxic, plastic, throwaway monster" because 40 tonnes of PVC will be used to cover it.

Gez Sagar, press spokesman for the dome project, said: "We have consistently asked Greenpeace to recommend a viable alternative to the fabric chosen to cover the dome but they have been unable to do so."
